question.text: In context of the lanthanoids, which of the following statements is not correct ?

options.text: All the members exhibit $+3$ oxidation state
Because of similar properties the separation of lanthanoids is not easy.
Availability of $4 \mathrm{f}$ electrons results in the formation of compounds in $+4$ state for all the members of the series.
There is a gradual decrease in the radii of the members with increasing atomic number in the series.

solution.text: The general o.s of lanthanides is $+3$, only few elements exhibit $+4$ o.s.
